meta.title: Privacy | Vitreva
meta.description: How Vitreva uses the details you send when you request a windshield replacement quote.

title: Privacy

sections.title: Browsing this site
body: You can browse this site without creating an account. The site does not use audience analytics or store your request in your browser.

sections.title: When you submit a request
body: When you submit a request, the details you enter are sent to Vitreva through Web3Forms, the form provider used on this site. They are used to understand your needs, prepare a quote and respond to you. Web3Forms also processes the data needed to deliver the form according to its own practices.

sections.title: What to send
body: Please do not send sensitive information that is unnecessary for your request. Your VIN is optional.

sections.title: Your personal information
body: For questions about your personal information, or to request its correction or deletion, email contact@vitreva.ca.
